title: Cecil Stops by with a Fine

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: Remind me, are you the one in charge of this... location?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Remind me, are you the one in charge of this... location?

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: And you're proud of this cess pit? This heap of ordure? This muck palace?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you're proud of this cess pit? This heap of ordure? This muck palace?

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: “Work” is putting it generously. Do you clean the floors or simply squirm around on them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: “Work” is putting it generously. Do you clean the floors or simply squirm around on them?

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: Unhygienic! It’s positively polluted! There! Is that a grease spot over one inch diameter? Let me get my measuring device…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unhygienic! It’s positively polluted! There! Is that a grease spot over one inch diameter? Let me get my measuring device…

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: Perhaps not to you. But to the Bureau of Sanitation it is positively crawling with Lims, I mean, lice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Perhaps not to you. But to the Bureau of Sanitation it is positively crawling with Lims, I mean, lice.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: I want to inspect every crevice of this germ-ridden enterprise. And then I want to purge it from existence!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I want to inspect every crevice of this germ-ridden enterprise. And then I want to purge it from existence!

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: What’s not fair is being stuck as a lowly inspector, poking around dives like yours, when I could be sweeping for nanoparticles in the Spire.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What’s not fair is being stuck as a lowly inspector, poking around dives like yours, when I could be sweeping for nanoparticles in the Spire.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: Not my dream. My calling. And I’ll be calling on you again soon. Good day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not my dream. My calling. And I’ll be calling on you again soon. Good day.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: This place honestly looks like the contents of a city dumpster have been emptied here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This place honestly looks like the contents of a city dumpster have been emptied here.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: But I’ll settle for issuing a Category D fine of, let’s see, fifty Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But I’ll settle for issuing a Category D fine of, let’s see, fifty Lims.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: Or I'm having a talk with my CorpSec contact regarding your license.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Or I'm having a talk with my CorpSec contact regarding your license.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I just work here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just work here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This is my place, yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is my place, yes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you implying that this place is unhygienic?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you implying that this place is unhygienic?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you implying that this place is unhygienic?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you implying that this place is unhygienic?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This place isn’t dirty.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This place isn’t dirty.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Say what you want or get out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Say what you want or get out.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Say what you want or get out.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Say what you want or get out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That’s not fair!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That’s not fair!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your dream is to inspect the Spire?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your dream is to inspect the Spire?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Your dream is to inspect the Spire?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Your dream is to inspect the Spire?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's an honest place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's an honest place.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your mom hated you, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your mom hated you, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seems harsh.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seems harsh.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Or what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Or what?

nodes.text: Cecil Stops by with a Fine
